title: Helly-type selection: a subsequence along which ∫ f dμ_j converges for every f ∈ C_c(U)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and (μ_j)_{j∈ℕ} Borel measures on ℝ^P such that sup_j μ_j(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Then there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ such that for every continuous f : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support and tsupport f ⊆ U the real sequence (∫ f dμ_{φ(j)})_{j∈ℕ} converges to some c ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ⨆ j, μs j K < ∞) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs (φ j))) atTop (𝓝 c)
